instruction: Candid realistic photograph, medium shot. In a bright white ballet studio, the blonde ballerina (R2) in a white leotard and sheer skirt stands on the left, holding the barre and smiling towards the right. On the right, the dark-haired ballerina (R1) in a white leotard and sheer skirt stands poised, looking forward with a calm expression. Soft, diffused daylight fills the room.
elements: R2 holds the ballet barre while R1 does not
R1 stands poised and looks forward while R2 smiles toward the right
R2 is the barre-contact dancer and R1 is the separate poised dancer
